name: pulpfixer-monorepo
description: pf: unified developer CLI for any repo, any language (monorepo root)
author: Max Glotov, Sam Pretorius

Develop.pf: Run the built pf from dist

Docs.docs:dev: Run the Nextra docs site locally on port 4400 (same as pf docs)
Docs.docs:build: Build the docs site and its search index

Build & check.build: Compile every package to its dist

Deploy.install:local: Build, pack and install pf globally from this checkout
Deploy.release: Check, build and dry-run publish of every package to cellars
Deploy.publish:cellars: Publish the new package versions to the cellars registry

Tools.skills:sync: Refresh the bundled /ver and /pnpm helpers from the skills checkout
Tools.logo: Regenerate the header art from packages/core/assets/pulpfixer.png (--preview to see it)
